title: Data Engineer
description: Sobre este rol Perfil orientado a computínes apasionado no solo por el valor de los datos, sino sobre todo por el cómo se construyen sistemas que son capaces de extraer valor. Funciones del cargo Como Data Engineer te tocará construir plataformas de datos abordando tanto la ingeniería de la ingesta batch y streaming de data, las estrategias de persistencia, modelamiento y auditoría, y la implementación de entregables de publicación de cara a consumidores (tanto usuarios como aplicaciones). Serás actor protagónico de nuestros esfuerzos de actualización permanente de tecnologías y prácticas en torno a los datos. Coordinarás el trabajo multidisciplinario entre equipos de data scientists, ingenieros backend y especialistas de visualización para que las plataformas que desarrolles cumplan sus objetivos estratégicos. Los desafíos serán constantes y tendrás acceso permanente a un equipo multidisciplinario incluyendo veteranos con experiencia real en proyectos de Big Data, que estarán muy dispuestos a compartir lo aprendido en los últimos 20 años, pero sobre todo interesados en acompañarte en tus ideas y apuestas. ¿Qué buscamos? Nos interesa motivación e interés y esperamos que lo acompañes con excelentes capacidades técnicas e intuición. Deberías tener unos 5 años de experiencia real entregando resultados concretos y tangibles, o bien menos experiencia pero demostrando fundamentos sólidos, capacidad de aprender rápidamente y entusiasmo para seguir un track de nivelación rápida. Nos consideramos agnósticos tecnológicamente, pero experiencia previa y bien fundada de Python, Postgres, Airflow, Elasticsearch y AWS (RDS, Athena, Glue, Kinesis, DynamoDB) son un gran plus. We want someone who's curious, pays attention to the details, and genuinely wants to get really good at paid digital advertising. If you've got solid hands-on experience running campaigns in Google Ads or Meta, and you're ready to take more ownership, let's talk. We don't take Google's recommendations at face value; we have the data and experience to know what actually works, and we'll teach you how to think that way too. This is a fully remote position. You can work from anywhere in the US. We use proven, tested strategies and let the data do the talking We check our egos at the door. description: ラグジュアリーへの情熱を、キャリアのチャンスに。 CXG は、顧客体験の分野で世界をリードする企業です。ファッション、美容、ジュエリー、自動車などの分野で、Louis Vuitton、Prada、Versaceなどの著名ブランドと連携しながら、あなたの力を発揮できる環境をご用意しています。 お仕事について： ラグジュアリーブランド評価者として、洗練されたブランドの世界に足を踏み入れ、顧客体験を観察・評価していただきます。 店舗訪問、オンライン購入、返品対応など、さまざまなシーンで得られたフィードバックは、ラグジュアリーブランドのサービス向上に活かされブランドを支えます。 あなたの声が、ラグジュアリーの未来を形づくります。 ・ 柔軟な働き方：1回の店舗訪問は約20分。空き時間を活用して複数のミッションに参加可能 ・継続的に参加できるミッション多数：月に複数回の評価業務あり。Louis Vuitton、Prada、Bentleyなど、世界的ブランドと関わるチャンスも 提携ブランド： ファッション＆クチュール Louis Vuitton、Saint Laurent、Balenciaga、Versace、Prada、Moncler、Fendi、Bottega Veneta、Ferragamo、COS、Bally、Dolce & Gabbana ジュエリー & 時計 Tiffany & Co.、De Beers、Piaget、IWC、Boucheron、Pandora ビューティー & スキンケア Guerlain、Sephora、L’Oréal、Givenchy 自動車 Bentley、Jaguar、Genesis、Maserati、Vespa 仕事内容： 1. ミッションを選ぶ：あなたの好みやプロフィールに合わせてミッションを選択 2. 店舗訪問またはオンラインで評価：実店舗で販売員とやり取り、または自宅からオンライン評価を実施 3. 公正かつ厳正に評価：店舗の雰囲気、サービス品質、顧客体験を細かくチェック 4. フィードバックの提供：専用プラットフォームを通じてアンケート形式で報告 このポジションの魅力： ・業界を代表する有名ブランドとのコラボレーション ・あなたの興味に応じた柔軟なミッションを選択可能 ・所要時間とフィードバックに対する報酬あり。購入型ミッションでは購入費の返金も ・ミッション管理・フィードバック提出が簡単にできるユーザーフレンドリーなプラットフォームあり CXG コミュニティへの参加方法： 1. 登録： にアクセスし、メールを確認 2. プロフィールを完成：必須項目を入力し、本人確認を完了 3. 認定取得：General Certification（一般認定）に合格してミッションにアクセス可能に 4. ミッションに応募：興味のあるブランドの案件に応募 5. 評価を開始：ラグジュアリー業界に貢献する第一歩を踏み出しましょう 謝礼： ・非購入ミッション：ミッションの複雑さに応じた謝礼を支給 ・購入ミッション：指定された条件を満たした商品について、ミッション内容に基づき返金 CXG について： CXG は、ラグジュアリーブランドと世界70カ国以上に広がる80,000人以上の評価者をつなぐグローバル企業です。 12の拠点を持ち、約20年にわたるラグジュアリーブランド向けの顧客体験分野での専門知識を活かし、ラグジュアリーブランドの顧客体験を再定義し続けています。 モバイル対応の「 CXG Live」プラットフォームを通じて、ミッション、認定、フィードバックのすべてをスムーズに管理できます。 Requirements ・18歳以上であること ・プレミアムブランドまたはラグジュアリーブランドの利用者であること ・評価の公平性を保つため、現在いかなるブランドとも業務契約していないこと ・時間を守り、計画的に行動し、細部に注意を払い、信頼できる方 ・観察力があり、顧客体験への関心・情熱がある方 ・経験は不問です。私たちは、実際のブランド利用者からの率直なフィードバックを大切にしています Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Outbound Marketing Specialist
description: iContainers is an online freight forwarding platform simplifies global shipping for businesses and individuals. Founded in 2007, it offers a user-friendly interface for booking and managing ocean and air freight services. iContainers enables companies and individuals to compare shipping rates, book FCL, LCL, and air shipments, and track cargo in real time, providing greater transparency and efficiency in the logistics process. In this role, you will develop and execute outbound marketing strategies to attract new business, promote our logistics solutions, and drive qualified leads to our sales team for all our business verticals, it requires a strategic thinker with strong communication and analytical skills who can effectively manage multiple campaigns across various channels, including email, social media, and direct outreach. Your Responsibilities Campaign Strategy & Execution: Design and implement targeted outbound marketing campaigns highlighting our logistics services, such as ocean freight, air freight, domestic shipments and tracking in the US, shop, and ship, returns management, international relocations, e-commerce, etc., including email, cold calling, direct mail, and social media. Cold Outreach & Follow-Up Conduct cold outreach via email and phone to potential clients in the logistics and supply chain industry, introducing them to our vertical solutions and qualifying leads for further sales engagement. Lead Generation & Nurturing Collaborate with sales and business development teams to identify target industries (e.g., retail, manufacturing, e-commerce) and decision-makers (e.g., supply chain managers operations directors) for outbound campaigns, generating and nurturing qualified leads for logistics services. Provide insights and recommendations for improving outreach strategies within the logistics sector. Management of Campaigns in our Marketing Tech Stack Use our CRM platform (Salesforce) and sales enablement tools (SalesLoft) to manage prospect databases. ensuring accurate tracking of interactions, lead segmentation, and communication follow-ups specific to logistics services Event & Webinar Promotion Continuously evaluate Support outbound marketing initiatives around logistics-related conferences, trade shows, webinars, and industry events. Support our team’s attendance at events through targeted outreach and follow-up campaigns. Social Media Management Manage our social media channels, primarily focusing on LinkedIn for B2B. You will need to become a LinkedIn champion. Given the business verticals that we have and will be opening, you will be recommending the ideal social media channels to focus on. You deal with them Collaboration Across Teams Work closely with the sales, logistics operations, and product development

title: Become a Freelance Luxury Brand Evaluator - Parndorf
description: Join the global community that enhances and elevates the experience of the most prestigious luxury brands in the world! CXG , a leading customer experience agency servicing premium and luxury brands, is looking for mission-based Customer Experience Evaluators who are existing luxury brand customers. As a Freelance Luxury Brand Evaluator, you can perform several evaluations per month and provide your valuable feedback via a questionnaire. Your assignments will be as diverse as our luxury clients and industries, ranging from fashion and high-end jewelry to cosmetics, luxury watches, automotives, and more. Your evaluations may involve visiting a store, returning a purchase, buying a product online, or making an appointment with a store. Please note: Applicants should not have worked for luxury retail brands to ensure the integrity and objectivity of the evaluations. Your feedback can influence brand strategies and help shape a brand's strategy, making this an opportunity for you to have a meaningful impact on the luxury market. Responsibilities: Conduct discreet evaluations of your favorite luxury brands in-store, online, or sometimes both. Provide objective feedback about your experiences. Choose assignments that align with your profile and interests. Complete questionnaires after each evaluation. Comply with all given project objectives and special requirements from the luxury brand we represent How to Apply: To become an evaluator with us, follow these simple steps: Register on live.cxg.com and receive an email with your credentials. Log into our platform and tell us more about yourself. Once this is done, our team will verify your profile and contact you. Check the ‘welcome package’ and pass the general certification. You’re now ready! You are now available for assignments and can browse and apply for any opportunities that interest you. About CXG : CXG is a global customer experience agency servicing premium and luxury brands. Our 12 offices around the world are able to service 70 countries. We are a team of 220+ customer experience experts and a network of over 80,000 evaluators worldwide. Learn more about what we do at . Enjoy the flexibility of working from our mobile application where you can search and apply for missions, take certifications, submit surveys, and much more, all on the go. Contact us for more information! Requirements Must be 18 years or older. Existing client of premium and luxury brands. Not contractually engaged with any retail brands, to maintain integrity. Punctual, organized, detail-oriented, reliable. Observant, passionate about customer experience. No prior experience needed, we look for honest feedback from real customers. This role is ideal for a PR freelancer who is looking to add a pro-bono good cause to their clients. This is the first PR role in the charity, so you would be a cornerstone in helping to shape and define the PR strategy for Frontline Live going forward. The role would involve the following: Develop the PR strategy for Frontline Live. Build and maintain relationships with journalists and key media outlets, particularly those in the Healthcare industry. Monitor coverage opportunities using your own/free PR tools and software. Monitor the Healthcare industry to come up with fresh PR stories or identify trends to piggy-back on. Outreach PR stories digitally to gain coverage from relevant publishers or to gain linkbacks from pages already covering relevant stories to ours. Write press releases and other material such as speaking points and statements. Maintain and update media lists and contact databases. Experience working in a PR role. Excellent written English. Access to PR tools to manage, track and monitor PR opportunities essential. Hence why this role would suit perfectly a PR freelancer with access to some of these tools already, as initially we wouldn’t have budget to finance them. Apart from having a full understanding of media needs and relationships, have an understanding of how PR, content, social and SEO can work together. Media contacts (publishers, journalist contacts, news outlets) or experience working with the Healthcare industry are both a huge advantage. Be Self-motivated, proactive and reliable, using your initiative to make things happen. Frontline.Live has recently gained official charity status, and for now is entirely staffed by volunteers. This volunteer position is entirely mouldable to your own living and working situation, and we'd love to hear from you, and how this might work for you. Frontline.Live harnesses the power of live, open data, to connect people in crisis with the resources they need. Currently, Frontline.Live is working hard to connect UK frontline healthcare workers with the PPE they lack, to aid in the Covid-19 crisis. By collecting, visualising and analysing data from suppliers & people in need, we show political and procurement bodies a more effective, more efficient and more human way of meeting needs in a time of crisis. title: Contract Paralegal
description: Looking for a contract paralegal to do mostly probate and estate planning work, to develop and improve the firm forms, to prepare written procedures for various tasks, and to do some training of the rest of the staff. The firm does a lot of other areas of law as well, so could be some work in other areas if desired (trademark, business, personal injury, construction). Must have meaningful experience in Arizona probate, including formal and informal probates, conservatorships and guardianships, and related; experience in estate planning, trust administration and Medicaid/ALTCS a big plus. Pay and Benefits: Pay is DOE. Position is for contract work, at least at first. The office is open from Monday-Friday 8:30-5:00, but we have some flexibility with those hours. Remote work is fine, where appropriate. To Apply: To be considered for this position, you must follow these directions completely. Automatically generated inquiries or responses that show us that you cannot follow directions will be immediately rejected. Send your application through this system with the words “I would love to join your team” in the subject line or at the top of the body text. Include the following with your submission: Your Name, Address, and contact information, including when you can be reached. We can call after hours if necessary. A cover letter or narrative in the body of your submission explaining your interest in our firm, our areas of practice, and your understanding of the requirements for this job. Also, tell us a little about yourself and why you believe you would be a good fit for this position. Don’t forget to include the words we’ve requested above. A copy of your resume, including all relevant experience and a list of three references. A description of your salary history and requirements. Completion of an initial assessment: You will be sent an assessment for you to complete as part of the initial application process. This is a critical element to our system, so WE WILL NOT REVIEW ANY APPLICATIONS UNTIL YOU HAVE TAKEN THAT ASSESSMENT. Please be sure to do so. Also, please understand that a final step in our hiring process is to have the candidates personally arrange calls with their former managers and others. No hard copies will be accepted. If we feel you meet our requirements for this position, we will contact you to schedule an interview. No phone calls or follow up emails, please. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. We are an established civil litigation and business law firm that is shifting its focus towards the estate planning, probate and bankruptcy. As part of this process we are rolling out a comprehensive law firm management system from an established and respected national estate planning law firm consultation group. We’ve been designing, implementing, managing, and protecting our clients’ mission-critical digital platforms and services since 2010. Our core values – purposeful, inclusive, excellent – drive everything we do, making us leaders, not followers. Choose to be part of Shaping Cloud and be at the forefront of innovation. title: Product Manager
description: Fully remote role! Who we are PartsTech is an automotive technology company. We help repair shops find the right parts fast. One search shows you live inventory and wholesale pricing from all of a shop’s parts suppliers. Repair shops rely on us to provide them with access to the necessary parts inventory to keep vehicles moving through their bays as quickly as possible. How we run things We always start with our product vision: we make it fast and easy for auto repair shops to find the right parts across all of their suppliers with one search. As a Product Manager you will report to the VP of Product and you will be a part of the product team which currently consists of product management, technical product management, product design, and user research. You will own at least one major area of the product or overall ecosystem. You’re responsible for identifying problems worth solving, prioritizing, contributing to the roadmap, and owning the execution and delivery. We already have great product designers. We are not looking for someone who wants to own design, but instead contributes where applicable to the design thinking process.You will be paired with a product designer where together you will help shape the future of the product. Our engineering team is awesome. Whatever we come up with they push to make it happen (just check out our product and you’ll see). Where we’re located We have strong roots in Massachusetts and Connecticut, but we’re a global team. You can expect to be working with team members throughout the U.S. and overseas. What we’re looking for You have a startup mentality. You are completely comfortable in an environment that moves quickly and easily pivots as new product-changing information becomes available. This doesn’t mean we’re changing the roadmap every two weeks, but it does mean we avoid the sunk cost fallacy (we don’t move forward with bad decisions just because we already put time into something). If you don’t meet everything on this list, but feel you are still a competitive candidate for the role, then apply. Comfortable working in an OKR environment You’re really good at asking why and truly understanding the problem You don’t just deliver features, you solve problems that translate into great features Experience in delivering incremental value, measuring, then modifying as needed until the desired result is achieved Ideally an example of sunsetting at least one feature Experience working with data and knowing the difference between being data informed vs data driven (we are more of a data informed environment) Experience in SaaS and E-commerce is preferred Experience with consumer products or B2B products that have delivered an experience expected of a consumer product Experience with e-commerce search and results (or different search with same level of complexity) Very familiar with design thinking and can give clear examples of how it is applied Has participated in or directly led design sprints Works directly

title: Marketing Manager
description: If you’ve successfully run fully integrated inbound marketing campaigns to drive demand generation and are ready for your next challenge, we need you!! Come and join the friendly and fast paced team at ScaleXP where you can make real a difference. You will be responsible to a wide range of marketing activities, from email campaigns to SEO to referral marketing. Key responsibilities include: Create & execute inbound marketing campaigns Drive inbound enquiries through organic SEO, app store listings, content marketing, and social media. Test and scale paid channels including paid search Optimise and scale our email outreach campaigns Craft a content strategy that targets all stages of the buyer's journey, from awareness to decision Report on campaign performance using analytics tools Improve and manage the company’s website, optimising to educate the market and convert leads You will have 3 to 5 years experience in B2B marketing, with ambitions to have greater impact and responsibility. Ideal skills and experience include: 3 - 5 years experience in B2B marketing Expertise in inbound marketing campaigns In-depth knowledge of SEM, both organic and paid Prior experience marketing to the accounting and bookkeeping channel Expertise in website conversion optimisation Exposure to email marketing, both outbound and lead nurture Data oriented, fluency using analytics Ability to collaborate on financial content Native English speaker, strong written communication Motivated, organised and ability to think both analytically and creatively Proactive, self-starter approach Experience working in a fast paced environment, with a strong understanding of how to iterate quickly Package, Perks & Benefits Opportunity to join an amazing and committed team, which has already ‘walked through walls’ to deliver solutions to our customers The potential to have huge impact on thousands of companies across the UK (and later globally) Hybrid working Competitive salary Generous package of stock options to ensure you benefit from the company's growth Flexible working hours, from 25 - 40 hours per week; you set the schedule, which can vary between term time and school holidays. ScaleXP is a high growth company creating an innovative software platform which revolutionises financial reporting and the month end process for SMEs and their accountants. The company is just 18 months old but has already been recognised for its innovation, with support from some of the most prestigious early stage investment groups in the UK. title: Staff Data Platform Engineer
description: NikoHealth is a rapidly growing SaaS company transforming how Durable Medical Equipment (DME) and Home Medical Equipment (HME) providers operate. Our innovative, all-in-one platform streamlines business operations, empowering providers to work smarter and more efficiently. About The Rol e This is a newly created role, and one of the first two engineering hires NikoHealth has made in the United States. You'll report directly to the CTO and own how data gets into our platform, out of it, and between the databases underneath it. Almost everything hard about bringing on a new customer is a data problem. Getting years of patient, order, and billing history out of a competitor's system and into ours currently runs on hand-run scripts, CSVs on a shared drive, and transform logic that lives outside version control. There's no CI on it, no dry run, and no safe way to re-run a failed load. Every migration adds weeks to an onboarding. Your first job is to turn that into a tested, repeatable pipeline, and then make how long onboarding takes a number we can actually report. It's the single clearest path we have to landing revenue we've already signed. The scope is the databases themselves and everything that moves data in and out of them. It's deliberately focused: this is the constraint on how fast we can bring customers live, and we'd rather you fix it properly than spread across everything. What you'll do in the first 6 months Get the migration pipeline into version control and under CI, with a dry-run mode and re-runs that don't corrupt anything. Publish our import contract, so onboarding teams and customers both know what good input looks like before anyone starts. Put a real measurement on onboarding time-to-live, reported separately for enterprise and small business. We can't currently tell a prospect how long it takes. Own database configuration, backup, and restore across the fleet, and prove a restore actually works. Plan the consolidation of our two database engines. Every customer runs both MySQL and PostgreSQL side by side with a live bridge between them, and untangling that is yours to scope, sequence, and execute. What we're looking for 5+ years in data engineering, data platform, or a closely related role. Strong SQL, including performance work on large tables, against PostgreSQL or MySQL. You'd work in both. Production ingestion pipelines you built and operated, where idempotency and safe re-runs were a design concern rather than an afterthought. Experience migrating customer data between systems where the source was messy and the customer was watching. Python, C# to the level where you own the transform layer outright. Daily working use of AI coding agents such as Cursor or Claude Code, including the harness around them: tests, project instructions, and a loop you can run again. Nice to have dbt, or a strong opinion about what the ETL layer should look like. Healthcare claims formats, particularly X12 837 and 835. A MySQL to PostgreSQL conso

title: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Controls Engineer
description: The Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Controls Engineer is responsible for designing, improving, and supporting control systems for RNG production facilities, with a practical focus on reliable plant operation. This role combines home-office engineering, field troubleshooting, commissioning support, and ongoing optimization of instrumentation, PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems. The Controls Engineer works closely with operations, maintenance, engineering, OEM suppliers, and environmental teams to improve gas quality, plant uptime, process safety, and regulatory compliance across operating anaerobic digestion facilities. This is a Remote position with travel required 25-50% to our on operations facilities as needed. description: Research Analyst Organisation: ALLSET Location: Remote Reporting to: Research Lead Contract: 1-year contract (3 days/week) with a 3-month probation period ALLSET is a climate preparedness research centre focused on how trust, moral values, and everyday life shape the way communities interpret, respond and recover from extreme weather events. Its focus is on applied research in climate-exacerbated disaster areas. The team has started projects in Northern Sumatra (Indonesia), Rio Grande do Sul (Brazil), El Salvador, Guatemala and Honduras (Central America), France and Greece (Southern Europe) and the Caribbean. VISION A world where extreme weather events are well understood by the communities who experience them and people have agency over the solutions that address them MISSION To conduct research focused on the lived experience of extreme weather events and draw upon these lessons to improve preparedness and adaptation efforts, as well as broader education and advocacy opportunities for climate change mitigation. What we aim to do ALLSET works with communities affected by extreme weather to understand how people experience disasters, navigate uncertainty and rebuild their lives. We examine how decisions are made under pressure, how local knowledge and trusted relationships shape responses, and how social, cultural and material conditions influence people's ability to prepare, cope and recover. Our research follows human response across the disaster cycle, from anticipation and immediate action to long-term recovery and adaptation. Using ethically rigorous, trauma-informed and culturally grounded methods, we bring together place-based inquiry, cross-context comparison and longitudinal learning to understand how experiences and behaviours evolve over time. ONE, ALLSET develops evidence on the human dimensions of extreme weather. We investigate how risk is understood, how people mobilise resources and support, and how formal systems are experienced in everyday life. This reveals the factors that enable or constrain individual and collective capacity, complementing technical and institutional assessments with insights grounded in lived reality. TWO, we connect this evidence with the organisations and networks that shape disaster response, including public institutions, humanitarian organisations, researchers, civil society, funders and community leaders. Through these relationships, we translate research into insights that can inform policy, practice, investment and public engagement, helping decision-makers design responses that are more responsive to the realities of the people they serve. Allset is seeking an experienced and driven Research Associate to conduct analysis of human-centered data in the context of extreme weather events. The Research Associate will strengthen ALLSET’s analytical and research capacity, supporting the rigorous analysis, synthesis and communication of findings across multiple geographies. title: Senior Director, AI Diagnostics
description: Headquarters: US Remote Natera is hiring a Senior Director to lead the research, development and clinical translation of AI and computational algorithms for oncology diagnostics, from research prioritization through validation, deployment, and ongoing performance monitoring. Natera’s longitudinal oncology data resources span tumor genomics, ctDNA, transcriptomics, pathology images, and clinical outcomes, creating opportunities to develop and validate models across molecular, imaging, and clinical data. This role turns that data into multimodal AI products that change how oncologists treat patients. We are looking for a scientific leader with a compelling vision for how foundation models can advance oncology diagnostics. You will shape our foundation model strategy - identifying the highest-value opportunities in longitudinal molecular, imaging, and clinical data, defining the capabilities we need to build, and guiding their translation into clinically useful products. This requires both the imagination to pursue new possibilities and the judgment to establish where these approaches deliver meaningful advantages. You will lead an established algorithm team, develop its technical and leadership capabilities, and recruit talent aligned with the product roadmap. With Product and other partners, you will set strategy and decide which opportunities move toward clinical deployment. Key Responsibilities: Build and lead the team: Grow the existing algorithm research team, hire key talent, and set a high bar for scientific rigor and execution. Own the path from research to launch: Establish development milestones and evidence-based go/no-go criteria from feasibility through validation and launch, with clear ownership, reproducible analyses, and documented decisions. Set strategy with Product: Partner with Product, Clinical, and Commercial leaders to prioritize clinical use cases, define intended use and success criteria, and make investment, continuation, and stop decisions based on evidence, feasibility, and clinical and business value. Push the technical frontier: Bring in foundation models and multimodal deep learning, and turn our data into products that set us apart from competitors. Deliver with quality: Make sure every algorithm is built on clean data, validated rigorously, and monitored after launch, so it holds up for clinicians, patients, and regulators. Qualifications: Ph.D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Machine Learning, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative field. A Master’s degree with substantial additional experience will be considered. Substantial experience developing computational products, including sustained leadership of multidisciplinary teams and ownership of complex development programs through clinical deployment. Demonstrated scope and impact equivalent to a Senior Director are more important than prior title.
